block.createpneumatics.roots_blower.tool: Turns rotation into _air pressure_. The front flange pushes, the back one pulls. Run it backwards and they swap.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_tube.to: Carries pressure from a _Roots Blower_. Leave an end open and it blows, or sucks, like a fan.
block.createpneumatics.pressure_gauge.to: Stick it on a tube to read its pressure. Puts out a _comparator_ signal and works with _Display Links_.
block.createpneumatics.relief_valve.tool: Stick it on a tube. Click it or give it _redstone_ to dump the whole network.
createpneumatics.jei.vacuum.chance: %s%% chance, lost if the vacuum breaks
Sits on a _basin_ or _depot_. Hook a tube that pulls _vacuum_ to it and it works what's underneath. Click it to vent and give up a batch.
item.createpneumatics.ration_pack.toolti: Freeze-dried stew. Fills you up and stacks, unlike the bowl it came from.
item.createpneumatics.optical_glass.tool: Glass with every bubble pulled out under vacuum.
block.createpneumatics.glass_pneumatic_t: A _Pneumatic Tube_ you can see into. Does the same job, and you get to watch your items fly past.
block.createpneumatics.vacuum_pad.toolti: Goes on a _contraption_. Lifts the block in front of it, contents and all, and puts it down again when the contraption stops. Works with _Mechanical Arms_ too.
block.createpneumatics.vacuum_tank.toolt: Holds vacuum for _Suction Pads_ and _Bell Jars_ riding the same contraption. Top it up at a _Pneumatic Interface_.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_interfa: Put one on a tube that pulls _vacuum_ and one on a contraption facing it. The contraption waits there until its tanks are full.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_termina: Feed it items and it shoots them down the tube. Items riding toward lower pressure drop into the terminal at the end of the line.
block.createpneumatics.air_diverter.tool: Sits in a tube line. Items matching its _filter_ go down its branch, everything else carries on.
